player_prompt.intro:
Ame wò Player {player_id} le agbalẽ HighSociety (agbalẽ 2-ame).
Agbalẽ ƒe mɔnu:  Kɔsi wò 10 prestige ƒe kaɖiwo le agbalẽ me.
Gbedo:    Agbalẽ ɖeka ɖeka, tsɔ kɔsi wò 1-11 ƒe kaɖi gbedo eye wòazu.
            • Gbedo kɔkɔe wòa nyagbɔgblɔ la prestige ƒe kaɖi eye wòa kɔsi wòa ɖe.
            • Gbedo viví la wòa kɔsi wòa.
            • Ŋku ɖeka -> gbedo eve wòazu eye prestige ƒe kaɖi ma wòa agbalẽ.
Kɔkɔe wòazu:    Agbalẽ wò 10 ƒe eme, ɖe **kɔsi wò + prestige akɔnta**.
            Nyagbɔgblɔ *ƒe akɔnta* wòa (ŋku ɖeka -> agbalẽ xɔxɔ). 

**Ɖo ƒe sintaks**  →  gbedo kɔsi wò ɖeka abe '[7]' alo '[11]'.
